[3:01PM] #Okota_Isolo #TrafficUpdate 

Vehicular movement from Cele towards Pako remains smooth, with the return journey equally free-flowing. The Cele linked bridge inward  Ijesha is also experiencing good movement in both directions. Traffic through the inner part of Nwachukwu Drive connecting to Cele is moving well, with no significant delays observed in either direction.

Along Ago Palace Road, traffic is encouraging in both inward and outward directions up to Apple Junction. Movement on Ibeh Road from Apata inward to Transformer Junction and further to Ilasa Under Bridge via the service lane is good in both directions. The inner stretch from Ire-Akari to Osolo Road is also free of congestion, with good flow on the return leg as well.

Traffic through Oke Afa, Pako, Kogberegbe, Ile Ibadan, Ishaga College, Omonide, Aye, and Limca Junction inward to Lasutech Roundabout and onward to Daleko Bridge is generally smooth, though traffic becomes slow around Palm Avenue Junction due to market activities at Daleko.

Movement from Five Stars, Iyana Isolo, and Iyana Itire inward to Ijesha Express on both the main carriageway and service lanes is currently good. No impediments have been recorded at this time.
